title: Evaluation Core Module
summary: This module provides the foundational components for defining, generating, and executing evaluation datasets. It includes data models for datasets, utilities for asynchronous task execution, and logic for AI-driven dataset generation.

nodes.label: Evaluation Dataset Schema
nodes.title: Dataset Definition
nodes.description: Defines the Pydantic model for evaluation datasets, including test cases, input/output types, and references to evaluators and report evaluators.

nodes.label: Generate Evaluation Data
nodes.title: Dataset Generation Logic
nodes.description: Leverages an LLM agent to create synthetic test cases, inputs, outputs, and metadata, structured according to a specified Dataset schema. Can save the generated dataset to a file.

nodes.label: Execute Single Evaluation Task
nodes.title: Task Execution Runner
nodes.description: Manages the execution of a single evaluation task, capturing its output, duration, and observability traces. Ensures proper context management for nested task runs.

nodes.label: Async Event Loop Utility
nodes.title: Event Loop Provider
nodes.description: Provides or creates an asyncio event loop, ensuring that asynchronous operations within the evaluation framework have a running event loop to execute on.

nodes.label: AI Agent
nodes.title: AI Agent for Generation
nodes.description: An AI agent component responsible for orchestrating calls to language models to fulfill complex tasks, such as generating structured data based on prompts and schemas.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: Underlying LLM
nodes.description: The actual large language model (e.g., GPT, Gemini) that provides text generation capabilities, used by the AI agent to produce dataset content.

nodes.label: Evaluator Definitions
nodes.title: Evaluator Schemas
nodes.description: Schemas and types for various evaluators and report evaluators, which are used to define how the generated dataset will be assessed.

nodes.label: Observability & Tracing
nodes.title: Tracing System
nodes.description: An external system (e.g., Logfire, OpenTelemetry) used to capture and monitor the execution flow, performance metrics, and contextual information of evaluation tasks.

nodes.label: File System Storage
nodes.title: Dataset Persistence
nodes.description: The local or remote file system used for saving and loading generated evaluation datasets, ensuring data persistence across sessions.

groups.label: Data Definition
groups.title: Evaluation Data Structures
groups.description: Components responsible for defining the schema and structure of evaluation datasets.

groups.label: Dataset Generation
groups.title: Automated Dataset Creation
groups.description: Logic and processes for programmatically generating evaluation datasets, often leveraging AI models.

groups.label: Task Execution & Utilities
groups.title: Core Execution Logic
groups.description: Components handling the execution of individual evaluation tasks and providing necessary asynchronous utilities.
